department: Department of Biomedical Engineering (Francis College of Engineering)

deadline.value: No deadline is stated on the biomedical engineering page.

gre_general.value: The biomedical engineering PhD requires GRE scores, and TOEFL if applicable.
gre_general.quote: GRE and TOEFL (if applicable) are required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Most doctoral students are supported, mainly by research grants and TA or RA positions for the first two years.
funding.quote: It is expected that the bulk of the funding will be from externally funded research grants.

also.quote: Doctoral students will be supported from a variety of sources.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's or master's in engineering or in basic, applied or health sciences.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the BME doctoral option are required to have a degree at the level of Bachelor or Master's in engineering or basic/applied/health sciences
